results.title: SIAM withdraws letter flagging concern over contamination of E20 fuel
results.description: SIAM withdraws letter warning on E20 fuel contamination after raising chloride corrosion and moisture concerns. ARAI report flags vehicle safety risks from chloride presence and high moisture levels above 1%. Industry insists no cause for alarm as issues have been addressed routinely.
